ALLOWED_REGIONS = ['North', 'South', 'East', 'West']
ALLOWED_CATEGORIES = ['Electronics', 'Accessories', 'Furniture', 'Office Supplies']

def clean(df):
    d = df.copy()
    # normalize Region label variants (case / whitespace)
    d['Region'] = d['Region'].astype('string').str.strip().str.title()
    d.loc[~d['Region'].isin(ALLOWED_REGIONS), 'Region'] = pd.NA
    # normalize Category labels too
    d['Category'] = d['Category'].astype('string').str.strip().str.title().replace({'Office Supplies': 'Office Supplies'})
    d.loc[~d['Category'].isin(ALLOWED_CATEGORIES), 'Category'] = pd.NA
    # numeric coercion
    for c in ['Quantity', 'Price', 'Revenue']:
        d[c] = pd.to_numeric(d[c], errors='coerce')
    # drop invalid rows: negative/non-positive quantity, missing price
    d = d[(d['Quantity'].notna()) & (d['Quantity'] >= 1) & (d['Quantity'] == d['Quantity'].round())]
    d = d[d['Price'].notna() & (d['Price'] >= 0)]
    # enforce Revenue = Quantity * Price
    d['Revenue'] = d['Quantity'] * d['Price']
    return d

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    d = d[d['Category'] == 'Electronics']
    d = d.dropna(subset=['Region'])
    g = d.groupby('Region')['Revenue'].sum()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in g.items()}
